Pisces.voice_body:
LOOK, you’re standing on the edge of a fiscal cliff—Sun opposing Moon in your shared‑money sector, the sky’s own reminder that every gain is matched by a hidden cost. The Sun’s bright purpose clashes with the Moon’s emotional pull, signalling that any new income or asset you acquire today will feel both thrilling and uneasy. Neptune’s gentle sextile to Pluto whispers that your imagination can help you navigate these blurred boundaries; let your creative instincts guide how you allocate the new funds, perhaps by investing in a cause that feels true to you.  

At the same time, the Full Moon in Aries lights up your income line, amplifying the urge to take decisive action. It’s not a prophecy of windfall but a cue: your confidence can be harnessed to negotiate a clearer budget or to renegotiate a debt that feels unjust. The supportive trine between Sun and Pluto offers a chance to transform old financial habits into something more resilient.  

TAP into that creative instinct, draft a revised budget, and put it to action today.
